text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Ministry Driss Basri says he will speed delivery of identity cards ahead of local council elections.
- Old-guard Istiqlal party says loss of confidence is main preoccupation of citizens preparing to vote in next elections because of previous bad experiences.
- Drop in cereal harvest to 3.35 million tonnes in 1996-97 from 10 million tonnes in 1995-96 is likely to result in more unemployment.
- Tourism official says VAT should be reduced to seven percent to allow fair competition with other Mediterranean destinations.
- Morocco beats Ghana in World Cup qualifier.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj forecasts over one billion dollar in foreign investments in Morocco this year.
